name: Mechanical Crafting
description: Crafting with a grid of Mechanical Crafters.

pages.title: Mechanical Crafting
pages.text:
**Mechanical crafting** uses a grid of Mechanical Crafters with their paths connected. It needs rotation and can craft recipes bigger than 3x3, such as the 5x5 Stellar Core.\
\
Fill every slot and it crafts. Press R over the result in JEI to see the layout.
